description: This dataset describes water quality around an excavated treatment pond receiving drainage from Corralanna peatland in Ireland. University College Dublin and Teesside University researchers collected fourteen outlet samples during March–October 2021 and eight monthly inlet-outlet pairs during September 2022–April 2023. Variables include nutrients, ions, dissolved-carbon properties, biochemical oxygen demand, turbidity, pH and conductivity. Mendeley version 2 supplies an Excel workbook free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is one treatment pond, and the first campaign lacks paired inlet observations. Sparse grabs, different campaign designs and variable retention times are limitations for estimating removal performance. Modellers could test retention or treatment-process assumptions in mine-water and drainage simulations. platform-goldsim-mine-water-waste and model-epa-swmm provide related environments requiring separate pond parameterisation. Companion repositories contain catchment flow and storm chemistry, not additional independent pond trials. No sample values were downloaded and no treatment-efficiency estimate was reproduced.
